questions.text: In a spreadsheet, cells B2 through B6 contain numeric marks. Which formula adds those cells without manually listing each value?
options: =COUNT(B2:B6)
=SUM(B2:B6)
=AVERAGE(B2:B6)
=MAX(B2:B6)

questions.text: You need to keep the first row visible while scrolling through a long worksheet. Which feature is designed for this?
options: Freeze Panes
Mail Merge
Slide Transition
Track Changes

questions.text: Which permission best fits a classmate who should inspect a shared cloud document but must not change it?
options: Editor
Owner
Viewer
Administrator

questions.text: A copied formula in D2 should always multiply each row's value by the fixed tax rate in B1. Which reference best preserves the tax-rate cell when copied down?
options: B1

questions.text: A chart compares enrolment across six departments, where the categories are separate and values need direct comparison. Which chart is generally clearest?
options: A 3-D pie chart with many slices
A column or bar chart with labelled categories
A decorative background image
A line chart that implies continuous time progression

questions.text: A presentation has detailed paragraphs on every slide and the presenter reads them word for word. Which change most directly improves audience comprehension?
options: Add more text so no detail is missing
Use random animations to retain attention
Remove headings to reduce visual clutter
Use concise key points and explain the detail verbally, with supporting visuals where useful

questions.text: A worksheet's totals look correct, but percentages change unexpectedly when a formula is copied down. Inspection shows the denominator reference shifts each row. What is the most likely correction?
options: Make the denominator absolute or fix its row/column as required, then verify copied formulas
Replace every formula with a screenshot
Convert all values to text
Use COUNT for all percentage calculations

questions.text: You need to send personalized letters to 80 students using the same layout but different names and enrollment numbers. Which workflow is most suitable?
options: Create 80 unrelated documents manually
Put all names into one paragraph
Use mail merge with a verified recipient data source and matching fields
Use slide transitions to replace names automatically

questions.text: A shared file must be readable by a project partner, while confidential editing remains restricted. Which action best meets the requirement and reduces accidental exposure?
options: Make the partner an owner and share the folder publicly
Grant viewer access to the intended account, verify link scope, and avoid public access unless needed
Grant editor access but ask the partner not to edit
Send the file link to the entire class so it is easy to find

questions.text: A spreadsheet shows #### in a date/number cell after a column is narrowed. The underlying formula is valid. What should be checked before changing the formula?
options: Whether the worksheet has a slide transition
Whether the file should be converted to a presentation
Whether all formulas should be replaced with constants
Column width and the cell's number format
